name: Flat Corner Lighting for Greedy Merged Quads
aliases: Flat corner lighting for greedy merged quads
definition: Samples the light level at a specific block position without AO to provide per-corner lighting for merged faces, allowing the GPU to interpolate a smooth light gradient without broken AO artifacts.
summary: Flat Corner Lighting calculates per-vertex lighting for greedy merged quads to enable smooth GPU-interpolated gradients, avoiding the broken ambient occlusion artifacts caused by per-face lighting.
